name: yolo
description: Launch AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, …) in an embedded terminal with clickable file/type links.

yolo.agents.markdownDescription:
User overrides / additions merged on top of the built-in catalog in agents.json. Override a built-in by matching its `command` (only the fields you set replace it, including `skipFlag` and `resumeFlag`); set `enabled: false` to hide a built-in; use a `command` not in agents.json to add a custom agent.

Edit it directly in **VS Code Settings** — there is no in-panel Settings UI; changes apply on the next launch. Example — change Claude's resume flag and hide Gemini:
```json
"yolo.agents": [
  { "command": "claude", "resumeFlag": "--continue" },
  { "command": "gemini", "enabled": false }
]
```

Launch args are ordered `baseArgs` → `skipFlag` → `resumeFlag`; `skipFlag` only appends when YOLO (skip-permissions) mode is on, `resumeFlag` only when Resume mode is on.

defaultSnippets.label: Override a built-in agent
defaultSnippets.description: Change only the fields you set on an agent from agents.json, matched by command.

defaultSnippets.label: Hide a built-in agent
defaultSnippets.description: Keep the agent in agents.json but stop showing it in the panel.

defaultSnippets.label: Add a custom agent
defaultSnippets.description: Add an agent that is not in agents.json (command only is enough).

command.markdownDescription: CLI binary launched in the terminal (also used for PATH detection). Required. Match a built-in's `command` to override it; use a new one to add a custom agent.

displayName.markdownDescription: Name shown in the panel. Defaults to `command` for custom agents.

baseArgs.markdownDescription: Space-separated arguments always passed to the command, before any mode flag (e.g. `agent` for `cursor-agent`, `run` for `kilo`).

skipFlag.markdownDescription: Space-separated flag appended when YOLO (skip-permissions) mode is on (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions` for Claude, `--yolo` for Gemini). Leave it empty to launch with no auto-approve flag.

resumeFlag.markdownDescription: Space-separated flag appended when Resume mode is on, to continue the most recent session (e.g. `-r` for Claude, `--resume` for Codex and Cursor). Omit it and the agent launches normally even in Resume mode.

iconFile.markdownDescription: Icon filename under the extension's `media/agents` folder (e.g. `claude.png`). If omitted, a default terminal icon is used.

enabled.markdownDescription: Set to `false` to hide an agent without deleting its entry.

id.markdownDescription: Optional stable id (defaults to `command`). An override may also match a built-in by its `id`.

yolo.permissionRules.markdownDescription:
Per-agent skip-permission flag, as a single list of `{ agentId, flag }` entries. `agentId` matches an agent's `command` or `id`; the `flag` is appended when YOLO mode is on, taking precedence over the agent's own `skipFlag` in `yolo.agents`. Prefer setting `skipFlag` directly on the agent in `yolo.agents`; use this only when you want one shared list. Example:
```json
"yolo.permissionRules": [
  { "agentId": "claude", "flag": "--dangerously-skip-permissions" },
  { "agentId": "codex", "flag": "--full-auto" }
]
```

agentId.markdownDescription: Agent `command` or `id` this rule applies to.

flag.markdownDescription: Space-separated flag appended when YOLO mode is on.

yolo.skipEnabled.markdownDescription: YOLO mode: launch agents with their skip-permission (auto-approve) flag so they run without permission prompts. Toggle it from the `$(zap)` button in the panel or `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Y`.

yolo.resumeMode.markdownDescription: Resume mode: launch agents with their `resumeFlag` to continue the most recent session. Toggle it from the `$(history)` button in the panel or `Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+R`.

yolo.lastAgentId.markdownDescription: Internal: the `id` of the agent last selected/launched, so the panel can pre-select it next time it opens. Set automatically — you normally don't edit this.

yolo.agentResumeFlags.markdownDescription:
Per-agent override of the resume flag used when Resume mode is on, keyed by agent `command` or `id`. Takes precedence over the built-in `resumeFlag` in agents.json / `yolo.agents`. Use this to tune resume behaviour per agent (e.g. choose between an interactive session picker and resuming the latest automatically) without editing agents.json. Example:
```json
"yolo.agentResumeFlags": {
  "codebuddy": "-r",
  "claude": "--resume"
}
```
When an agent is absent here, its `resumeFlag` from agents.json (or `yolo.agents`) is used.

yolo.agentBaseArgs.markdownDescription:
Extra launch args per agent, keyed by the agent's lower-cased `id` (falls back to a match against `command`). Appended after the agent's own `baseArgs` from `yolo.agents`. Prefer setting `baseArgs` on the agent in `yolo.agents`; use this only when you want one shared map. Example:
```json
"yolo.agentBaseArgs": { "cursor-agent": "agent", "kilo": "run" }
```

yolo.installedCommands.markdownDescription: Internal cache of AI agent commands detected on PATH. Maintained automatically — do not edit by hand. (internal)

yolo.shell.markdownDescription: Override the shell used to launch agents and probe PATH. Absolute path or a binary name on PATH. On Windows, leaving this empty auto-detects a POSIX shell (Git Bash / WSL) when needed; otherwise `cmd.exe` is used.

yolo.shellArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments passed to the shell before the agent command (e.g. `["-l"]`). Ignored on Windows `cmd.exe`.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
